moat_against: No demonstrated returns on capital: operating losses every filed year, conservative OE negative 0/3 filed years and on TTM; roic_proxy is LBO/IPO denominator noise, not a through-cycle ROIC record
Microsoft Entra bundles governance into the M365 relationship — the strategically decisive competitor; Okta, CyberArk/Palo Alto, Saviynt and AI-native vendors converge from every layer
SBC is a heavy recurring cost: $238.2M TTM (~20% of TTM revenue), exceeding TTM free cash flow of $194.9M; post-IPO diluted share count still rising (544.2M FY2026 → 566.4M YTD FY2027)
Gross margin 64.5% (FY2025-26) is mid-pack for SaaS — term-license and services mix, no elite pricing-power signature yet
Controlled company: Thoma Bravo retains a majority stake; the June 2026 Entro acquisition (~$200M reported) adds integration risk in non-human identity
moat_for: Category leader in identity governance (IGA) — rated best-tier for governance in 2026 buyer comparisons; ~3,235 customers per company filings
Compliance-mandated switching costs: access-certification and lifecycle workflows embedded in regulated-industry audit processes; implementations are multi-year and painful to rip out
Retention in the numbers: dollar-based net retention 113%, gross retention in the high 90s (Q2 FY2027)
SaaS transition compounding: SaaS ARR +36% YoY to $847M and 97% of net new ARR; AI/agentic-identity ARR above $70M with a pipeline above $200M
moat_justification: SailPoint is the recognized leader in identity governance and administration (IGA) — the governance layer enterprises buy on top of whichever identity anchor (Microsoft Entra, Okta) they run — with compliance-mandated switching costs: access-certification and lifecycle workflows are embedded in regulated-industry audit processes and implementations run for years. Retention confirms it: dollar-based net retention 113% and gross retention in the high 90s (Q2 FY2027 reporting), ARR $1.231B growing 25%, SaaS ARR +36% to $847M. But there is no demonstrated return on capital: operating income is negative in every filed year, conservative owner's earnings are negative 0 of 3 filed years and on TTM, and the roic_proxy series in fundamentals.json (+34.9% FY2024, +3.2% FY2025, -3.7% FY2026) is denominator noise from the Thoma Bravo LBO (negative book equity pre-IPO) and the February 2025 re-IPO recapitalization, with D&A of $211-264M/yr dominated by amortization of acquisition intangibles. Gross margin (60.5% FY2024 → 64.5% FY2025 → 64.5% FY2026 → 66.2% TTM) is improving but mid-pack for SaaS, not an elite pricing-power signature. Microsoft bundling Entra governance into M365 is the standing erosion force, with Okta, CyberArk (now Palo Alto Networks), Saviynt and AI-native entrants converging on the same agentic-identity ground. A 5 gives CAP 8.5 years.
name: SailPoint, Inc.
one_liner: Identity-governance category leader with real switching costs, moat 5/10 — but conservative owner's earnings are negative in every filed year and on TTM (TTM base -$0.08/share; normalized median -$1.71/share) because SBC of $238M TTM consumes all of the $195M TTM free cash flow — Tier F; it does not clear 15% at any price on current numbers and no hurdle-clearing price exists on a negative base. ARR +25% (SaaS +36%) is a re-rating story until SBC falls below operating cash generation.
